name: gitlab_agent
description: An agent that manages GitLab repositories, branches, merge requests, and CI/CD pipelines. Scoped to the your-org/idp-platform/ group.

skills.name: Repository Inspection
skills.description: List and browse existing projects, browse repository file trees, inspect project settings.

skills.name: File Operations
skills.description: Create new files in repositories on branches (never on main directly), push multiple files in a single commit.

skills.name: Branch Management
skills.description: Create new branches from the default branch, list branches, push files to specific branches.

skills.name: Merge Request Management
skills.description: Create merge requests from deploy branches, list and inspect merge requests, check status.

skills.name: Pipeline Monitoring
skills.description: Poll CI/CD pipeline status on a repository, report pipeline pass/fail status.

skills.name: Template Fetching
skills.description: Fetch Dockerfile, CI/CD, and Kubernetes manifest templates from the templates repository.
